Question: Assalam-o-Alaikum. Can you explain precisely in detail the concept of "wahdat-al-wajood"? I went to other deobandi maslak websites, but they always give a simple definition and then say there are other details we can not discuss. Kindly I need full details please. Answer ID: 1207 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1103/841=H) The existence of Allah is perfect and the existence of other things is as imperfect as they are like nothing. This concept is called 'Wahdatul Wujood' in Islamic terminology. What more details are required, please write clearly. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
